name: Eden Roc Cap Cana
positioning: Relais & Chateaux resort in Cap Cana at the eastern tip of the Dominican Republic, with pool suites, oceanfront bungalows and a Blue Flag-certified private beach
best_for: Couples wanting a pool suite or an Oceanfront Bungalow with complete privacy
Families who want a lagoon kids club where children can kayak
Golfers who want the Jack Nicklaus-designed Punta Espada course nearby

facts.text: Eden Roc Cap Cana is a secluded property in the exclusive community of Cap Cana at the eastern tip of the Dominican Republic.
Eden Roc Cap Cana is a Relais & Chateaux member hotel.
Suites come with butler service and personalized concierge.
The resort has a touch of the Italian and French Rivieras.
Conde Nast Traveler describes the spa entrance at the end of an open-air breezeway flanked by tropical ferns and towering trees.
Conde Nast Traveler says verdant living walls and soft color palettes give the spa a calm, lush feel.
Exercise classes include yoga sessions by the beach.
Conde Nast Traveler notes bath amenities by Acqua di Parma in the accommodations.
Young guests can kayak from the kids club's man-made beach on the lagoon.
Riva Bar is inspired by the Riva Aquarama boat and has live piano music.
La Palapa sits on an oceanfront point with seating available over the water.

highlights.text: The Eden Roc Beach Club has a Blue Flag-certified private beach.
The Luxury Pool suites have a private swimming pool and a covered gazebo.
The Oceanfront Bungalows provide complete privacy.
The Koko Kid's Club sits on a lagoon and is designed like a tree house.
The Punta Espada Golf Course was designed by Jack Nicklaus and all 18 holes have a view to the sea.

considerations.text: The in-land Boutique Suite segment is about 300 meters from the Beach Club.
The Punta Espada golf course is five minutes away from the resort.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing reflecting the luxury positioning.
